features.title: Content contract
features.tldr: projects.ts is the one project schema, links are http(s), v1.json its input-mode export; verify parses the locales, checks key parity and every asset.
features.summary: The site's content JSON has one machine contract built on the one project schema; verify's unit tests parse the three locale files against it, keep the exported JSON Schema equal to a fresh export, and hold every rule on the files under public/assets.

features.title: Deploy infrastructure
features.tldr: One Terraform module serves the built site from a private S3 bucket through CloudFront, per env (stage, prod), applied and deployed by GitHub Actions over OIDC.
features.summary: terraform/modules/portfolio-static-site is the one topology, called by envs/stage and envs/prod; the terraform workflow plans on PRs and applies on push, the deploy workflow syncs dist/ and invalidates CloudFront; a one-time script creates the OIDC provider and a temporary bootstrap role.

features.title: Local Flask servers
features.tldr: backend/ holds Flask servers that serve frontend/dist on localhost; scripts start them; nothing in CI, deploy or the frontend uses them.
features.summary: Three Flask scripts serve the built frontend with an index.html fallback on ports 8000 or 8001, started by hand or by build_and_serve.sh and server_manager.sh; production is the static site, and Vite's own dev and preview servers cover local work.

features.title: Legacy specs and screenshots
features.tldr: specs-bkp/ is the pre-canon specs tree kept by specs init and img/ holds site screenshots; both are reading material only, unread by the site and its gates.
features.summary: specs-bkp/ holds the specs tree as it stood before the current specs/ canon, the input the first-pass audit reads to fill memory; img/ holds phone and desktop screenshots of the site. No build, test, workflow or runtime path reads either.

features.title: Scene media pipeline and player
features.tldr: Scenes recorded from a pinned PyPI version, hash-named under byte budgets, played muted and looped, a still under reduced motion.
features.summary: A developer tool in frontend/media turns a pinned package's real terminal output into hash-named webm, mp4 and poster cuts, and publishes SVG scene pairs; the Media component plays them in view, picks the cut by width and shows the still when motion is reduced.

features.title: dadaia-workspace project page
features.tldr: The library page for dadaia-workspace, pinned to PyPI 0.4.7 and tag v0.4.7, with a hero loop, three scenes, a pinned Try it and facts from the tag.
features.summary: The projectsV2 item slug dadaia-workspace, kind library, in the three locale content files; every claim on it states what the pinned PyPI release ships and links its source at the pinned git tag.

features.title: Library project page layout
features.tldr: The one library page layout - purpose, install line, hero loop, side-by-side scenes, Try it, Why it exists, facts pinned to a tag.
features.summary: LibraryProjectTemplate renders a library item in a fixed order from its content alone; scene sections sit text beside media on wide screens, and the facts heading names the library and its pinned version.

features.title: rand-engine project page
features.tldr: The library page for rand-engine, pinned to PyPI 0.8.0 and tag 0.8.0, with a hero loop, three scenes, a runnable Try it and facts from the tag.
features.summary: The projectsV2 item slug rand-engine, kind library, in the three locale content files; its scenes, example and facts state what the pinned PyPI release ships, each fact linked to its source at the pinned git tag.

features.title: End-to-end suite
features.tldr: Playwright runs nine smoke specs on every PR and the full suite weekly, against a local server on port 8080 with the pt-BR locale.
features.summary: playwright.config.ts picks the smoke set under E2E_SMOKE, else every spec under tests/e2e; CI runs Chromium against vite preview of the built dist, locally five browser projects against the dev server.

features.title: Resume home
features.tldr: The home is a frameless resume - hero, experience, two projects, skills, certifications, education - every number and word read from content.
features.summary: Portfolio renders Hero, Experience, Projects, Skills, Certifications and Education in one column with no section card or fold; the hero's stat line is derived from content, role periods are localized by one parser, and the only disclosures are the story toggle and each role's Details control.

features.title: Analytics SDK
features.tldr: A vendored dependency-free SDK queues anonymous events per tab session and sends them by sendBeacon when the page hides.
features.summary: frontend/vendor/analytics-sdk is installed as @dadaia/analytics-sdk; main.tsx calls init with the build's VITE_ANALYTICS_ENDPOINT, and the site's track calls record page views, CV downloads, theme and language switches, role disclosures and project actions.

features.title: Shared site chrome
features.tldr: One header and one footer on every route, one 960 px column with 680 px prose, one type scale, localized chrome strings and <html lang>.
features.summary: A layout route renders the one header, the one main landmark in the site's 960 px column and the one footer for every page; the project routes add a breadcrumb and back link; chrome text, theme first paint and the document language follow the visitor's locale and stored theme.
